(5) Handler: no OAuthClient with client_id = username AND client_secret = password gives 401 {"detail":"unauthenticated"} (no WWW-Authenticate). A token not found for that client, or one that _check_access_token rejects, gives 200 {"active":false}. Else 200 {"active":true,"client_id":username,"scope":...,"exp":created_at Unix + expires_in}, compact JSON in that key order.
